cards.card_text: Nothing to fill the reaper's hands, nothing for the arms of the binder of sheaves.
cards.verse_text: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
cards.snippet: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.

cards.card_text: The LORD compares it to a reaper gathering the standing grain with his arm, like someone gleaning heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
cards.verse_text: “In that day the splendor of Jacob will fade, and the fat of his body will waste away, as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the ears with his arm, as one gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
cards.snippet: …fade, and the fat of his body will waste away, as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the ears with his arm, as…

cards.card_text: Then comes the word of the LORD: the corpses of men will fall like dung on the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper.
cards.verse_text: Declare that this is what the LORD says: “The corpses of men will fall like dung upon the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.”
cards.snippet: …like dung upon the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.”

cards.card_text: The LORD says the days are coming when "…the plowman will overtake the reaper…" What does that picture show?
cards.verse_text: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed.
cards.snippet: …days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed.

cards.card_text: Jesus says the reaper is already gathering a crop for eternal life, so the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
cards.verse_text: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
cards.snippet: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that…
